proposed.text: Who has authority to approve the examination syllabi for the Architect Licensure Examination?

options.text: The President of the Philippines, acting through the Office of the Executive Secretary
Individual university architecture departments, each setting their own standards and guidelines
The Board of Architecture in consultation with the CHED-accredited academe
The Professional Regulation Commission without consultation, based on internal policy decisions

rationale.a: Overstates executive authority; presidential approval is not required for examination syllabus development.
rationale.b: Fragments authority inappropriately; individual universities do not approve syllabi; the Board coordinates with CHED-accredited schools collectively.
rationale.d: Contradicts the collaborative requirement; RA 9266 mandates consultation with academe, not unilateral PRC action.
rationale.correct: RA 9266 Section 8(j) of the IRR establishes that the Board develops examination syllabi in consultation with the academe to ensure alignment with curriculum standards to ensure alignment with curriculum standards at recognized architecture schools.
rationale.takeaway: ALE syllabi authority: Board of Architecture in consultation with CHED-accredited academic institutions.

proposed.explanation: Source-audited against Section 7(j), which gives the Board power to prescribe and adopt syllabi, and Section 14, which allows revision, exclusion, or addition of subjects and syllabi subject to Commission approval.
